تتذاكرون (form VI)
# تَتَذَاكَرُونَ (tataḏākarūna) /ta.ta.ðaː.ka.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
# تُتَذَاكَرُونَ (tutaḏākarūna) /tu.ta.ðaː.ka.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
